details.name: Yvonne
details.quote: Hi, Endmin. We meet again. Just call me Yvonne. It's been a very long time since I last went out. Pleasure doing business together!
details.infection: Oripathy negative, based on medical examination reports.
details.exp1d: Epiphany: Spark of Design She's always filled with wild, imaginative ideas. In fact, she managed to assemble modules that couldn't be more different to create gadgets with strange, unexpected functions.
details.exp2d: Team Management: Efficiency Her bot companions never tire, follow her every whim, and guarantee her work efficiency.
details.hb1d: Fashion: Machine Aesthetics A leader of Endfield fashion and trends. Yvonne treats science as a form of aesthetics, and aesthetics as a form of science.
details.hb2d: Technology: Ætherside Deciphering She stands at the very fringe of Ætherside technology of Talos-II. Every step she takes is an all-new adventure.
